subject: Life Skills
title: Emotional Spending
description: A quick, practical guide to Emotional Spending.

hook.text: After a terrible week, she bought three dresses online at midnight. They arrived. She returned all three.

buildup.text: Retail therapy is real — shopping triggers dopamine. The brain rewards the anticipation of buying, not the owning.

discovery.text: Stress, sadness, boredom, and even celebration all trigger spending.

twist.text: Emotional Spending has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Add a 24-hour rule for unplanned purchases over $50. Most emotional buys lose their appeal within a single day.

punchline.text: If the urge does not survive a night's sleep, neither should the purchase.

quiz.question: What does the brain actually reward during shopping?
options: The anticipation and act of buying, not the owning
The social status of making a purchase
